rules.name: Azure Storage Account Name
rules.pattern:
(?x)
(?:
  # A) Connection string: AccountName=<name>
  (?i:AccountName)\s*=\s*["']?([a-z0-9]{5,24})["']?(?:\b|[^a-z0-9])
|
  # B) Blob endpoint URL: <name>.blob.core.windows.net
  ([a-z0-9]{5,24})\.blob\.core\.windows\.net\b
|
  # C) Explicit KV labels near 'azure storage/account name' with tight separators
  \b(?i:azure)(?:[_\s-]*)(?i:storage|account)(?:[_\s-]*)(?i:name)\b
  [\s:=\"']{0,6}
  ["']?([a-z0-9]{5,24})["']?(?:\b|[^a-z0-9])
|
  # D) Explicit KV labels with tight separator and Azure-shaped value.
  # Value is case-sensitive lowercase (real Azure storage names are lowercase
  # letters + digits only, 3-24 chars; min 5 filters common short words).
  (?i:Account[_.-]?Name|Storage[_.-]?(?:Name))
  \s*[:=]\s*
  ["']?([a-z0-9]{5,24})["']?(?:\b|[^a-z0-9])
)

rules.name: Azure Storage Account Key
rules.pattern:
(?x)
# Avoid leading \b: env vars like MONGODB_..._AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_KEY have no
# word break before AZURE (alnum or underscore). Consume a non-lowercase char (or
# start-of-input) so we still block mid-camelCase (myAzureStorage...) without using
# a lookbehind, which Vectorscan and the Rust regex crate both reject.
(?:\A|[^a-z])
(?:
  (?i:azure)(?:[_\s-]*(?i:storage))?
  (?:[_\s-]*(?:account[_\s-]*key|storage[_\s-]*key|shared[_\s-]*key|access[_\s-]*key|accountkey))
  |
  (?i:account)[_.\s-]*(?i:key)
  |
  (?i:storage)[_.\s-]*(?i:key)
)
\b
(?:.|[\n\r]){0,24}?
(?:
  [=:]
  |
  ["']\s*:\s*["']
)
\s*
["']?
(
  [A-Za-z0-9+/]{86}==
)
['"]?

rules.name: CockroachDB Cloud Service Account API Key
Coinbase CDP API Key (ECDSA)
rules.pattern:
(?xims)
  "name"\s*:\s*"
  (?P<CRED_NAME>organizations/[0-9a-f-]{36}/apiKeys/[0-9a-f-]{36})"
  .*"privateKey"\s*:\s*"
  (?P<PRIVATE_KEY>
    -----BEGIN\sEC\s{0,1}
    PRIVATE\sKEY
    (\sBLOCK)?
    -----
    [a-z0-9 /+=\r\n\\n]{32,}?
    -----END\s
    (?:
      RSA |
      PGP |
      DSA |
      OPENSSH |
      ENCRYPTED |
      EC
    )?
    \s{0,1}
    PRIVATE\sKEY
    (\sBLOCK)?
    -----
  )
